objective:
Follow these steps literally, one at a time, from the current page. Click only what each step names. Never type a URL, search, or take another route.
1. Click the element whose visible label is exactly 'Filter'.
2. Click the element whose visible label is exactly 'Location'.
3. Click the element whose visible label is exactly 'Country'.
Then store the main heading of the page you end on as 'landed_on'.

actions.intent: PRIMARY: Click the element whose visible label is exactly 'Filter'; role=button; text="Filter" | HINTS: position=top toolbar above dashboard metrics
actions.instr: Clicking Filter in the top toolbar

actions.intent: PRIMARY: Click the element whose visible label is exactly 'Location'; role=button; text="Location" | HINTS: container=expanded Filter menu near top toolbar
actions.instr: Clicking Location button in the filter menu

actions.intent: PRIMARY: Click the element whose visible label is exactly 'Country'; role=button; text="Country" | HINTS: container=expanded Location submenu within Filter menu
actions.instr: Clicking Country button in Filter submenu

actions.intent: the main heading of the current page
